answer: Each identity must hold a certified welder registration, earned with a supervised weld test and a certification exam costing about $200 per candidate. A farm needs a distinct certified welder per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost $200,000 plus a supervised weld test each. The beacon of cheap aliases dims: every fake adds another exam, the spiral of the weld register exposes shared certificates, and the meadow of fake welders thins under renewal fees.
